description: This PHP file defines the DetailView2 class, a subclass of EditView, responsible for rendering a detailed view of a record within the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic for setup and configuration of view metadata, instantiation of template handlers, and metadata generation if absent.

classes.name: DetailView2
classes.description: A class responsible for displaying the detailed view of a record in SuiteCRM, extending EditView and handling setup of view metadata and templates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detailed view, including loading metadata, setting up the template handler, and managing view configurations and error handling.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the bean object with request data, extending the parent method from EditView.
